name: Filled Etched Phial
summary: In Thunder Bluff, the tauren seek a dryad phial filled with moonwell water. Its rare spiritual power can quench the eternal flame shielding a sacred centaur relic.

sections.title: Moonwell Waters and Dryad Craft
sections.body: To fill the phial, you must enter night elf territory deep in Ashenvale. Dryads around Raynewood Retreat carry the empty vessels, crafted to hold pure restorative draughts. A sacred moonwell near the western bank of the Falfarren River fills the phial with water rich in celestial and nature-bound power. Night elves regard taking it without leave as desecration. The tauren see the water as vital to meeting a threat farther south.

sections.title: A Key to Centaur Sorcery
sections.body: Zangen Stonehoof and Rau Cliffrunner sought this water for the deep ties between dryads and centaur. Both trace their ancestry to Cenarius, and their magic shares a primal resonance. In Thousand Needles, the Galak clan guards an ancient relic behind an unyielding protective flame said to date from the creation of the centaur race. The moonwell water in the dryad phial can pierce and extinguish that ward.

faq.q: What is inside the Filled Etched Phial?
aliases: what water is in the phial
what is etched phial filled with
faq.answer: The Filled Etched Phial holds sacred water drawn from a night elf moonwell in Ashenvale, near the Falfarren River. The ornate glass vessel comes from dryads near Raynewood Retreat.

faq.q: Why do the tauren need moonwell water?
aliases: why does rau need moonwell water
faq.answer: Rau Cliffrunner needs the sanctified water to pierce and extinguish the protective flame guarding the Galak centaur relic in Thousand Needles. Dryads and centaur share ancestry through Cenarius, giving the moonwell water power against the ancient ward.

faq.q: Where does the empty phial come from?
aliases: where do i find etched phial
faq.answer: Laughing Sisters, dryads who wander the woods around Raynewood Retreat in central Ashenvale, carry the empty phials.

faq.q: Who do you deliver the Filled Etched Phial to?
faq.answer: After you collect the water, take it first to Zangen Stonehoof on the High Rise in Thunder Bluff. He directs you to bring it to Rau Cliffrunner at Freewind Post in Thousand Needles.

angles.text: For tauren, securing this water strikes at the Galak centaur, turning Cenarius's shared nature magic against their longtime tribal enemies.
As a night elf, you know the theft of a dryad's phial and the skimming of moonwell water by Horde agents violate Ashenvale's holiest sanctuaries.
